completion_notes: Added six targeted construction-time validations to ProblemIR.__post_init__: (a) duplicate boundary names; (b) BC components in [0, dim); (c) coordinate-name uniqueness; (d) duplicate FieldSpec names; (e) BC field_name consistency with declared fields. The required-material-params check (P3-5f) lives on ProblemIR.assert_mvp_stable() rather than __post_init__ so in-tree research code that builds minimal IRs for shape-only testing keeps working; compile_latex now calls assert_mvp_stable() so the canonical compile path enforces the contract at the user-visible boundary. Two pre-existing tests with wrong J2 param names (sigma_y vs sigma_y0) and incomplete params were corrected — the new validation surfaces silent acceptance bugs that had been sitting in the suite. 22/22 P3-5 tests pass; full mechdsl-core suite stays at 1499 pass / 0 fail (82 skipped, 110 deselected: slow/gpu/e2e markers).
